{{Quote|I cannot find it anywhere on the manifest for you to have this spice. And my manager said this is highly irregular. Yes.|The worker, to Rafa Martez|<ref name="Together Again" />}}
A [[Toong]] [[Gender|male]] '''worker''' served under a [[Unidentified Trandoshan manager|Trandoshan manager]] at a [[Pyke Syndicate]] [[spice]] shipping dock on [[Oba Diah]]. When attempting to trick the [[Pyke]]s into releasing their associate [[Ahsoka Tano]], [[Rafa Martez|Rafa]] and [[Trace Martez]] tried to steal [[spice]] from the dock, claiming they had a delivery order. The worker called his manager for assistance, and the Trandoshan attempted to [[Death|kill]] the [[Martez family|Martez sisters]] after discovering they had lied. Trace Martez incapacitated the worker while her sister fought and defeated the manager, and the two left with the stolen spice.<ref name="Together Again" />
